title: Building Your Professional Network
intro: Networking is a powerful tool that supports service members and their spouses throughout military life and beyond. Building meaningful professional relationships during your military career and transition can significantly boost your chances of success—whether in employment, education, or entrepreneurship.

sections.heading: Resources for Military Spouses
sections.markdown:
Military spouses have access to a wide range of support programs both on and off installation:

* Career development tools
* Workshops and trainings
* Networking events
* Hiring fairs

Best of all, many of these programs are available at no cost, helping you prepare for success during military life and beyond.

sections.heading: How Marines Can Maximize Networking
sections.markdown:
The [Transition Readiness Program (TRP)](https://www.usmc-mccs.org/trp) is designed to guide Marines through every phase of the Marine Life Cycle. TRP provides:

* Career exploration tools
* Resume and interview coaching
* Access to employers, mentors, and veteran networks

Engaging with TRP early and consistently can help Marines secure informational interviews, gain insider perspectives, and even land job offers before separation.

sections.heading: Stay Connected and Grow Your Network
sections.markdown:
Networking doesn't stop once you make a connection. Strengthen your network by:

* [Volunteering](https://www.usmc-mccs.org/vounteer) and participating in community events.
* Connecting with others during PCS moves - each move is a chance to build new relationships and expand your network.
* Getting involved with Marine Corps Community Services (MCCS) programs and professional organizations.

Using social media platforms to maintain and cultivate these relationships. Over time, your network can become a powerful asset—opening doors to your next career opportunity.

sections.heading: Get Started Today
sections.markdown: Contact your local [Family Member Employment Assistance Program](https://www.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/military-family-life/family-member-employment-assistance-program) or [Transition Readiness Program (TRP)](https://www.usmc-mccs.org/trp) to learn how to start building your network now. The connections you make today could shape the success you experience tomorrow.
